   "source": [
    "<font size = \"5\"> **Chapter 2: [Diffraction](CH2_00-Diffraction.ipynb)** </font>\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "<hr style=\"height:1px;border-top:4px solid #FF8200\" />\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Fourier Transform - A laboratory\n",
    "\n",
    "[![OpenInColab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](\n",
    "    https://colab.research.google.com/github/gduscher/MSE672-Introduction-to-TEM/blob/main//Diffraction/CH2_06b-FFT.ipynb)\n",
    " \n",
    "part of\n",
    "\n",
    "<font size = \"5\"> **[MSE672:  Introduction to Transmission Electron Microscopy](../_MSE672_Intro_TEM.ipynb)**</font>\n",
    "\n",
    "**Spring 2026**<br>\n",
    "by Gerd Duscher\n",
    "\n",
    "Microscopy Facilities<br>\n",
    "Institute of Advanced Materials & Manufacturing<br>\n",
    "Materials Science & Engineering<br>\n",
    "The University of Tennessee, Knoxville\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "Background and methods to analysis and quantification of data acquired with transmission electron microscopes.\n",
    "\n",
    "## Load necessary packages\n",
    "\n",
    "We only need matplotlib and numpy \n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Periodic Delta Functions"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "1.0\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "[<matplotlib.lines.Line2D at 0x24d2a6cc550>]"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "data =np.zeros(101)\n",
    "for i in range(11):\n",
    "    data[i*10] = 1.\n",
    "for i in range(6,11):\n",
    "    data[i*10] = -1.\n",
    "\n",
    "print(data.sum())\n",
    "data[50] = 0\n",
    "# data = np.cos((np.arange(101)-50))\n",
    "\n",
    "x = np.linspace(-50, 50, data.shape[0])   # mm\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "plt.plot(x, data)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x24d2a733610>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fft_of_data = np.fft.fftshift(np.fft.fft(data))\n",
    "fft_of_data[49:51] = 0\n",
    "fft_x = np.fft.fftshift(np.fft.fftfreq(len(data)))\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, fft_of_data.real, label='real')\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, fft_of_data.imag, label='imag')\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, np.abs(fft_of_data), label='mag')\n",
    "#plt.plot(fft_x, np.angle(fft_of_data), label='phase')\n",
    "plt.legend()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## FFT of sine and cosine Functions"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "[<matplotlib.lines.Line2D at 0x24d2a47f110>]"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "data =np.zeros(101)\n",
    "\n",
    "data = np.sin((np.arange(101)-50)*.4)\n",
    "\n",
    "x = np.linspace(-50, 50, data.shape[0])   # mm\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "plt.plot(x, data)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x24d2a4f6210>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fft_of_data = np.fft.fftshift(np.fft.fft(data))\n",
    "fft_of_data[49:51] = 0\n",
    "fft_x = np.fft.fftshift(np.fft.fftfreq(len(data)))\n",
    "plt.figure()\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, fft_of_data.real, label='real')\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, fft_of_data.imag, label='imag')\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, np.abs(fft_of_data), label='mag')\n",
    "plt.plot(fft_x, np.angle(fft_of_data), label='phase')\n",
    "plt.legend()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Conclusion \n",
    "\n",
    "The Fourier Transform gives the frequencies of sine waves to reproduce the original data\n",
    "\n",
    "The fast fourier functions of numpy are used throughout the course."
